image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a large metal tray containing several bagels. Some bagels are sliced open and filled with a thick white cream cheese spread. Others appear to be plain or topped with seeds. In the background, a person wearing a dark jacket is visible, holding a phone, and there is a wire basket containing more bagels. The lighting is somewhat dim and warm, suggesting an indoor bakery or deli setting.
